name: io.github.rayhyman333-blip/cynthia
title: Cynthia
description: Verified-answer AI assistant: answers only from 216 owner-approved facts, never invents.

tools.name: ask_cynthia
tools.description:
Ask Cynthia a question. She answers ONLY from her verified
    knowledge, returning the verified answer verbatim labelled
    "Verified answer". If the question is not in her verified knowledge,
    she honestly abstains instead of guessing.

    Questions asked in Spanish are answered in Spanish from her
    verified Spanish store, under the same rules ("Respuesta
    verificada"). Questions asked in French are answered in French
    from her verified French store, under the same rules ("Réponse
    vérifiée"). The language is detected from the question itself, or
    forced with the language argument.

    Args:
        question: The question to ask Cynthia, in plain English,
            Spanish or French.
        language: Optional language hint: "es"/"spanish" for Spanish,
            "fr"/"french" for French, "en"/"english" for English.
            Leave empty to auto-detect.

tools.name: ask_tutor
tools.description:
Ask Course Tutor Cynthia a course-content question about a topic
    covered in a Planet Leads Academy course. She answers ONLY from the
    verified lesson text of the 35 Academy courses (280 lessons),
    returning a verbatim excerpt from the matching lesson, cited as
    (Course name — Lesson N: Lesson title). If no lesson matches
    confidently, she honestly says she does not have verified material
    on that yet instead of guessing. For questions about Cynthia,
    Planet Leads, prices, or policies, use ask_cynthia instead.

    Args:
        question: The course-content question, in plain English.

tools.name: cynthia_capabilities
tools.description:
Describe what Cynthia can do and the rules she follows
    (verified answers only, owner approval on risky actions,
    free-only building, subscription guard, and more).

tools.name: cynthia_question_digest
tools.description:
Owner digest of the questions asked on this server instance:
    how many questions matched each verified fact, the top questions
    with no verified answer yet (the content roadmap), and the most
    recent questions. The log holds only question text, matched fact
    id (or no-match), and a timestamp — no personal data — is bounded
    to the most recent 2000 questions, and resets when the service
    restarts.

tools.name: cynthia_status
tools.description:
Report the Cynthia MCP server version, the number of verified
    facts in her knowledge store, and a health check.
